rows.label: qst610502_msg0002
rows.name: I'm a failure as a lookout...

rows.label: qst610502_msg0003
rows.name:
I failed the mission the commander
gave me...

rows.label: qst610502_msg0004
rows.name:
What am I supposed to do after they
kick me out of the Superbian army...?

rows.label: qst610502_msg0005
rows.name:
Do you know how this tower got its
name?

rows.label: qst610502_msg0006
rows.name:
Long ago, there was an incredibly
skilled old sniper named Bazuain.

rows.label: qst610502_msg0007
rows.name:
Apparently, from here he took out
monsters and outlaws trying to enter
the capital.

rows.label: qst610502_msg0008
rows.name:
He let no one near the tower and
protected the capital's peace all by
himself.

rows.label: qst610502_msg0009
rows.name:
The commander recognized my sniping
skill and told me to become Bazuain.

rows.label: qst610502_msg0010
rows.name:
The Special Commissioner came to
persuade me?

rows.label: qst610502_msg0011
rows.name: But that has nothing to do with me.

rows.label: qst610502_msg0012
rows.name:
I've no intention of listening to
someone I've never seen or met.

rows.label: qst610502_msg0013
rows.name: But you lot are stronger than I am.

rows.label: qst610502_msg0016
rows.name:
So I'm to go to Temperantia and
eliminate anyone trying to misuse the
Divine Beast weapons.

rows.label: qst610502_msg0017
rows.name: I regret not becoming Bazuain, but...

rows.label: qst610502_msg0018
rows.name:
If these are my new orders, I'll carry
them out properly.
